release: Dual projection models (Standard and Momentum) preview
purpose: Narrow, additions-only exception to the V6 protected-path guard for the reviewed dual projection files. Applies only to pull requests from dual-projection-development in this repository; every other branch keeps the strict byte-identical guard. No existing protected file may change. Remove after the dual projection release is merged.

added_files.src/cfb_analytics/dual_projection.py: Standard and Momentum engine: shared opponent fit, per-model weighting, projections and win distributions
added_files.src/cfb_analytics/dual_evaluation.py: Walk-forward historical evaluation against the incumbent replay (never changes published forecasts)
added_files.src/cfb_analytics/dual_publish.py: Publishes the preview projections file; conference and CFP odds use the unchanged incumbent simulation
added_files.web/public/dual-projections.json: Published preview projections for the Model Projections section
